svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Languages: Python, Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, R, Swift, HTML, CSS, Bash. Research & machine learning: PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, scikit-learn, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Nilearn, NiBabel, UMAP, Statsmodels, Optuna, Ray Tune. Apps & interfaces: React, React Native, Expo, Tauri, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Zod, HealthKit, Canvas 2D. Backends & model APIs: FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn, SQLite / SQL, Anthropic API, Ollama. Tools & testing: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, QEMU, Node.js, VS Code, Figma, Codex, Claude Code, Jupyter, pytest, Jest, ESLint, Ruff. The ASCII flower overlays the right edges of equal-width transparent boxes.
